svg.title: Inbound A2A pipeline
svg.desc: An envelope arrives directly or via the optional relay, passes signature, protocol and replay checks, rate limit, an audit-first record, the consent check for personal-data origins, then either a stored task or a gated worker spawn with a per-origin tool denylist; the result is filtered; any failure returns an opaque rejected.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens when an envelope arrives

svg.text: POST /v1/a2a/receive — every check fails closed with the same opaque answer.
